content_sections.heading: AIIMS Kalyani Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
AIIMS Kalyani Assistant Professor Selection Process 2026
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Kalyani Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the AIIMS Kalyani recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the AIIMS Kalyani recruitment is Assistant Professor (Contractual).

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy has been announced for the Assistant Professor (Contractual) position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 29 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree along with an MD in Radiotherapy or an equivalent qualification, and have at least 3 years of teaching and/or research experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Assistant Professor (Contractual) post is 50 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor (Contractual) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 1,42,506/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to take place?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at All India Institute of Medical Sciences Kalyani, Kalyani, West Bengal, 741245.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.
